get.description: Saved values for OVAs (properties, network mapping, passwords), one or more per product.

schema.title: Response List Appliance Profiles Api V1 Appliance Profiles Get

post.description:
Values are checked against the OVA's descriptor (``image_id``): unknown keys, types, choices and
length limits are 422 with field errors. Passwords go in ``secrets`` and are never returned.

put.description: Replace a profile. Omitted passwords are kept; the OVA must be the same product.

schema.title: Response List Bios Profiles Api V1 Bios Profiles Get

post.description: Every value is checked against the registry: allowed values, bounds, read-only. No passwords.

From a file: {attribute: value}, {"Attributes": {...}}, or a Dell Server Configuration Profile JSON.
Settings the BIOS won't take (read-only, passwords) are left out.

delete.description: Refused while a spec's Configure BIOS step uses it.

schema.title: Response List Bios Registries Api V1 Bios Registries Get
Response List Clusters Api V1 Clusters Get

delete.description: Members keep their hostnames and IPs as their own per-host values.

put.description: Change the cluster. Members keep their names and addresses; the range must still contain them.

post.description:
Add a server: its hostname comes from its BMC's name (read-only), its IP is the next free one in the
range, and both are written as its per-host values.

get.description:
Every member's report, and what should match across them (model, BIOS, firmware, memory, ...) with
the items that differ flagged.
Every member's components in one sheet (the server reports' rows, one after another).
The comparison as CSV: one row per item, one column per member, and whether it differs.

post.description:
Run every member's spec at once (a member's own spec, else the cluster's). A member that fails
doesn't stop the others.

schema.title: Response Start Cluster Run Api V1 Clusters  Cluster Id  Runs Post
Response List Config Sets Api V1 Config Sets Get

put.description: Replace a config set. Omit root_password to keep the stored one.

schema.title: Response List Hosts Api V1 Hosts Get

get.description: What Configure BIOS would write now, with or without a profile (from the inventory; no BMC calls).

post.description:
A profile from the server's current BIOS settings (its latest inventory). Reads the registry from the
BMC if it isn't cached yet (read-only).

get.description:
The settable BIOS attributes of this server, in setup order. Cached per model and BIOS version;
read from the BMC (read-only) the first time or with ``refresh``.
Pinned BMC/OS certificates (trust on first use). Credentials are only sent to these.

schema.title: Response List Certificates Api V1 Hosts  Host Id  Certificates Get

post.description:
Accept the certificate the BMC ("bmc") or installed OS ("os") presents now. Use only after a
legitimate change (reinstall, renewed certificate): this replaces the pin.

schema.title: Response Get Host Values Api V1 Hosts  Host Id  Host Values  Family  Get

put.description: Per-server values (e.g. hostname, ip) validated against the OS family's schema.

schema.title: Response Set Host Values Api V1 Hosts  Host Id  Host Values  Family  Put

post.description: Show the spec and kickstart a deployment would use (password hidden). Touches nothing.

put.description: Record how to reach the OS currently installed on the host (e.g. ESXi management IP).

get.description: The latest output of each kind for this host: what later tasks will use as their inputs.

schema.title: Response List Outputs Api V1 Hosts  Host Id  Outputs Get

get.description:
The latest output of one kind (e.g. inventory, preflight, os_network, install, readiness,
vcf_readiness, host_prep, jumbo, holorouter). Each kind has a fixed shape; see GET /tasks.

schema.title: Response Get Output Api V1 Hosts  Host Id  Outputs  Kind  Get

put.description:
Record or correct an output by hand (its source becomes "manual"). The body must match the kind's
schema (GET /output-kinds); later tasks read it as their input. Nothing on the server changes: editing
the Holorouter's record does not reconfigure the Holorouter.

schema.title: Response Set Output Api V1 Hosts  Host Id  Outputs  Kind  Put

get.description:
Every task from bare metal to Holodeck for this host: its state (done, stale, ready, blocked,
running, failed, planned), what blocks it, its last job and output, plus the recommended next step.

The server's full hardware inventory (firmware, CPUs, memory modules, drives, adapters, PCIe devices,
power supplies) and its configuration state (spec, last run, OS, boot volume, every task's result).
The same as one row per component: server, section, component, model, version, detail, health.

schema.title: Response List Host Runs Api V1 Hosts  Host Id  Runs Get

post.description:
Run the server's spec: steps start one after another and the run stops at the first failure.
``confirm`` approves every step, destructive ones included.

get.description:
What running this server's spec would do now: each step runs, is skipped (done or not needed), or
is blocked; the destructive steps; and the phrase that starts it.
The spec this server runs: its own, else its cluster's, else null.

schema.title: Response Get Host Spec Api V1 Hosts  Host Id  Spec Get

put.description: Give the server its own spec (it overrides its cluster's), or null to use its cluster's.

schema.title: Response Set Host Spec Api V1 Hosts  Host Id  Spec Put

get.description:
What Configure storage would change with this profile: each change (and whether it loses data), and
why it can't go ahead, if it can't. From the last Read storage; nothing is read or changed.

post.description: A profile describing the server's layout as Read storage last saw it (nothing is read or changed).

Start a catalog task (GET /tasks). 409 if its inputs are missing or stale (the message says which
task to run first). Destructive tasks need ``confirm``.

get.description: The VMs on the host's installed ESXi, read live (read-only): candidates to adopt or capture.

schema.title: Response List Vms Api V1 Hosts  Host Id  Vms Get

get.description: Stock installer ISOs and appliance OVAs found in the repository folder (you add/remove files there).

schema.title: Response List Images Api V1 Images Get
Response Rescan Images Api V1 Images Rescan Post

get.description:
An OVA's descriptor: product, networks, size, and every input (OVF property) it takes, plus a
JSON Schema of the inputs a person sets.

schema.title: Response List Jobs Api V1 Jobs Get

get.description:
A redacted debugging bundle: the job and its steps, the host and BMC identity, and every
Redfish/ESXi exchange (method, path, status, timing, truncated body). Passwords, tokens and session
secrets are removed. Attach it to a bug report when a BMC behaves unexpectedly.

schema.title: Response Job Diagnostics Api V1 Jobs  Job Id  Diagnostics Get

get.description: OS families with the JSON schemas the UI renders config-set and per-server forms from.

schema.title: Response List Os Families Api V1 Os Families Get

get.description: Every output kind a task can produce (and you can set by hand): its title and JSON Schema.

schema.title: Response Output Kinds Api V1 Output Kinds Get

post.description: Stop the run: its current job is cancelled and no later step starts.

schema.title: Response List Specs Api V1 Specs Get

post.description:
Every step is checked: the task exists, its parameters are valid, and what they refer to (images,
config sets, profiles) exists. Steps are kept in pipeline order. Secrets are refused.

delete.description: Servers that had it as their own spec fall back to their cluster's. Refused while a cluster uses it.

schema.title: Response List Storage Profiles Api V1 Storage Profiles Get

delete.description: Refused while a spec's Configure storage step uses it.

get.description: The task catalog: what each task needs (``requires``) and makes (``produces``), in pipeline order.

schema.title: Response List Tasks Api V1 Tasks Get
